dishes.name: Dibbelabbes
dishes.desc: Grated potato baked in a pot with leeks and smoked meat, served with apple sauce. The Saarland's most typical home dish.

dishes.name: Gefillde
dishes.desc: Large potato dumplings filled with minced meat or liver sausage, served with bacon sauce or sauerkraut. Saarland comfort food.

dishes.name: Schwenkbraten
dishes.desc: Marinated pork steaks grilled over beech wood on a swinging tripod grill. The Saarland's summer barbecue.

dishes.name: Lyoner
dishes.desc: Ring-shaped pork and beef sausage, eaten fried, boiled or cold. Saarlanders treat it as their own despite the French name.

dishes.name: Hoorische
dishes.desc: Long potato dumplings boiled in water and served with bacon sauce or sauerkraut. An old Saarland dish.
